repo.name: Aquamarine
repo.description: Tweaks by Thonin for rootless jailbreaks (iOS 15+).

com.thonin.chargewatts.tagline: Live charging watts under your battery icon.
com.thonin.chargewatts.description:
Shows how many watts are really going into your iPhone while it charges — a small pill right under the battery icon, on the Home Screen, Lock Screen and in portrait apps.

- Reads the power chip's own charge counters, so it updates twice a second instead of every 20 seconds
- Accurate to within a few percent of the battery driver's own energy counter
- Hides when unplugged, in landscape apps and while the screen is off (no battery cost)
- Touches pass straight through it

com.thonin.doubletaplock.tagline: Double-tap to lock — and to unlock.
com.thonin.doubletaplock.description:
Double-tap empty space to lock or unlock your iPhone.

- Home Screen: double-tap empty space to lock — the screen turns off, exactly like the side button
- Lock Screen: double-tap empty space to unlock — exactly like swiping up, so Face ID or your passcode is still required
- Taps on icons, widgets, notifications, the flashlight/camera buttons and the passcode keypad keep working normally
changelog: Double-tap to lock is now Home Screen only — the app switcher closes on the first tap of empty space, so a double-tap could never land there.
Locking now turns the screen off, exactly like pressing the side button (it used to show the Lock Screen with the screen still on).

com.thonin.powermodes.tagline: Battery Saver, Balanced and Performance — plus a 3-day trial of every Pro mode.
com.thonin.powermodes.description:
Power modes that change real iOS settings — and always put yours back.

- Battery Saver: Low Power Mode, dark appearance, Reduce Transparency & Motion, no auto-play, Background App Refresh off
- Balanced: everything Power Modes changed goes back to your own settings (anything you changed by hand is left alone)
- Performance: Low Power Mode off, background refresh paused, heat guard if the phone gets very hot
- Live status: battery, Low Power Mode and the exact battery temperature
- Uninstalling puts your settings back too

Free 3-day trial of everything in Power Modes Pro: Auto (switches by game, charger and your battery levels), Fast Charge + switch on plug-in, Gaming with per-game Game Mode rules, Ultra Saver and your own Auto levels. After the trial the free modes keep working.
changelog: First release: Battery Saver, Balanced and Performance, with a free 3-day trial of every Pro feature.

com.thonin.closeall.tagline: Close every app at once — keep the ones you lock.
com.thonin.closeall.description:
Close all your apps from the app switcher in one go.

- Tap Close All at the bottom of the app switcher, or swipe down anywhere in it
- Hold a card for half a second to lock that app — locked apps show a padlock and are never closed by Close All (hold again to unlock)
- The app playing music or audio is kept too
- Apps really quit, exactly like swiping each one up
- Works with any number of open apps; when nothing's left, you're back on the Home Screen
- The button and padlocks only appear in the app switcher, never over your apps

com.thonin.fulloff.tagline: Control Center's Wi-Fi and Bluetooth really turn off.
com.thonin.fulloff.description:
Since iOS 11, the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth buttons in Control Center only disconnect you "until tomorrow" — the radios stay on. FullOff makes them switch the radio fully off, exactly like the switch in Settings.

- Works everywhere Control Center shows them: the Connectivity group, the separate Wi-Fi and Bluetooth buttons, and the expanded network list
- Turning them back on works as usual and reconnects to your network or devices
- Fully off means AirDrop, Personal Hotspot and an Apple Watch's Bluetooth link go off too — same as Settings
- No settings, nothing running in the background: it only acts when you tap
